rules: Only APPROVED may unlock the next phase.
PARTIAL does not unlock the next phase unless a later APPROVED decision supersedes it.
A decision must reference one immutable handoff file and its SHA-256.
Accepted object IDs must be canonicalized before APPROVED is recorded.
Rejected and deferred objects remain preserved in the raw handoff.
Reviewer and decided_at are mandatory for any non-PENDING decision.
All five checks must be true for APPROVED.
The integration log is append-only by integration_id.
